name: exhaustive-finite
label: Exhaustive finite-domain verification
description: PROOF of the bounded statement: checks the predicate over the COMPLETE cartesian product of declared integer ranges (≤ 5M cases, memoized). Exit 0 = holds everywhere → claim about that finite domain VERIFIED. Exit 1 = exact counterexample found → claim FALSIFIED. State the claim's bound honestly: '∀ n in [1, K]' is what gets verified, never '∀ n'.

inputs.name: expression
inputs.description: integer arithmetic over the variables (usually just "n")
